headline: A Pakistani astronaut will travel to China's Tiangong space station aboard the Shenzhou-24 mission, becoming the first foreigner to visit it, China's manned space agency said on Saturday, Dawn reports citing AFP.

card.desc: Station jane wala pehla ghair mulki hoga: China ki space agency

caption:
Pakistani astronaut China ke space station jayega!
Dawn ke mutabiq China ki manned space agency ne Saturday ko bataya ke ek Pakistani astronaut Shenzhou-24 mission par Tiangong space station jayega aur wahan jane wala pehla ghair mulki hoga. Rawangi ki tareekh nahi batayi gayi, magar mission saal ke aakhir tak mutawaqqe hai.
